# TebScribe

> TebScribe LLC is a New York limited liability company founded by Dr. Mohammad Chelehmalzadeh, a practicing emergency medicine physician. Built by an ER doctor, it makes tebIQ (an AI medical scribe for clinical documentation), tebDictate (a free medical dictation app) and tebChart (a discharge instructions app for iPhone), plus Bellody (a family organizer) and tebCapture (send video from your phone to your computer, encrypted). Encrypted in transit and at rest (AES). Never used for training. Never sold.

## tebIQ — AI medical scribe

tebIQ is an AI medical scribe, also called an ambient scribe or AI scribe for doctors, for clinicians. It listens to the patient encounter and drafts the clinical documentation: a SOAP note, or history, medical decision making, assessment and plan for emergency medicine, shaped for the specialty. It also supports nurse notes. It runs in a web browser, on iPhone, on Apple Watch and on Android. The clinician reviews and signs every note; tebIQ does not diagnose or treat.

- Website: https://tebiq.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756632709
- Pricing: https://tebiq.com/pricing
- Security: https://tebiq.com/security

## tebDictate — free medical dictation app

tebDictate is a free medical dictation app and dictation app. Open tebdictate.com on any computer, scan the QR code with your phone, and use voice to text (speech to text) to dictate to any computer; your phone is the wireless microphone. It works for nurse dictation and doctor dictation, needs no account and nothing to install, and the connection is end-to-end encrypted. Speech is recognized on your phone.

- Website: https://tebdictate.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790673075

## tebChart — discharge instructions app

tebChart is a discharge instructions app and medication list app for iPhone, a hospital discharge app for patients and their caregiver. Scan your discharge papers and it organizes the after visit summary, your medications, follow-up visits and the questions worth asking. Records are stored privately on your iPhone, with no health records on TebScribe servers.

- Website: https://tebchart.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782081865

## Other products

- [Bellody](https://tebscribe.com/bellody/): keeps your family's schedule, school, chores, co-parenting and caregiver info on your iPhone.
- [tebCapture](https://tebscribe.com/tebcapture/): your phone is an encrypted camera; send video to your computer.
